svg.aria-label: The coastline as vector data: points connected in order
svg.text: Natural Earth 1:50 million: a good 1 400 polylines with a total of 60 416 points.
Each point is a pair of longitude and latitude; the points of a polyline are connected in order.
Sardinia is one polyline with 82 points,
Between the points the coast runs as a straight segment.
Land area (only says where inside is)
